This project is a work in progress - resurrecting the F3 programming language.

Lazy and reactive self-adjusting computation with mutation

Support for generics including type constructors

Syntax - "plain english" where possible

Higher order functions

{{{
function of (a, b, c) curry(f is function from (a, b) to c) returns function from a to (function from b to c)
{
    function(x is a) returns function from b to c
    {
        function(y is b) returns c
        {
            f(x, y)
        }
    }
}

function of (a, b, c) uncurry(f is function from a to (function from b to c)) returns function from (a, b) to c
{
    function(x is a, y is b) returns c
    {
        f(x)(y)
    }
}
}}}

Monad Comprehensions
{{{

// Lazy infinite streams

public class Stream of a extends Comonad of a, Monad of a {

    public val first is a;
    public val secondThruLast is Stream of a;

    // zip lifts a binary operator to one over Streams
    public function of (b, c) 
	zip(binOp is function from (a, b) to c, 
	    xs is Stream of b) returns Stream of c
    {
	Stream of c
	{
	    first: bind binOp(first, xs.first);
	    secondThruLast: bind secondThruLast.zip(binOp, xs.secondThruLast);
	}
    }

    // map lifts a unary operator to one over Streams
    override public function of b 
	map(unaryOp is function from a to b) returns Stream of b
    {
	Stream of b
	{
	    first: bind unaryOp(this.first);
	    secondThruLast: bind this.secondThruLast.map(unaryOp);
	}
    }

    // flatmap lifts a Stream constructor to a unary operator over Streams
    override public function of b 
	flatmap(ctor is function from a to Stream of b) returns Stream of b
    {
        val d = bound function(x is a) returns b { ctor(x).first }
        var h = bind d(first);
        var t = bind for (x in secondThruLast) d(x);
        Stream of b {
            first: bind h;
            secondThruLast: bind t;
        }
    }

    // coflatmap lifts a Stream destructor to a unary operator over Streams
    override function of b 
	coflatmap(dtor is function from Stream of a to b) returns Stream of b
    {
	Stream of b
	{
	    first: bind dtor(this);
	    secondThruLast: bind secondThruLast.coflatmap(dtor);
	}
    }

    override public function extract() returns a { first }

    public bound function fby(s is Stream of a) returns Stream of a 
    {
	Stream of a {
	    first: bind first;
	    secondThruLast: bind s; 
	}
    }
}

// lifts a constant to a Stream i.e,  x, x, x, ...
public function of a toStream(x is a) returns Stream of a
{
    Stream of a {
        first: x;
        override val secondThruLast = this;
    }
}


// creates an infinite stream of 3s
val zs = bind for (xs in toStream(1), ys in toStream(2)) { x + y }

}}}
